title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
abstract: arXiv:2610.29177v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. translated_title: ROCOCO：被遮挡曲线目标的鲁棒轮廓补全
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种基于学习的生成模型，用于在环境障碍物遮挡的情况下补全曲线特征。为此，我们采用了一种基于流匹配的方法，支持用适当的曲线特征对遮挡区域进行修复。为了消除对遮挡先验特权信息的依赖，我们还训练了一个基于UNet的掩码预测模型，该模型仅需被遮挡的观测即可识别需要修复的区域。我们通过使用程序生成的测试用例进行实验验证了方法的各个组件，并使用大型公开的曲线目标数据集验证了完整的流水线。与现成的图像修复基线相比，当未提供遮挡掩码时，ROCOCO以显著优势成为最强的方法；当提供掩码时，它与掩码监督的修复方法具有竞争力，在全图误差上取得最佳表现，在遮挡区域上仅次于LaMa。
tldr: 该论文提出ROCOCO，一种基于流匹配的生成模型，结合UNet遮挡掩码预测，无需先验遮挡信息即可鲁棒地补全被环境障碍物遮挡的曲线目标轮廓，性能显著超越现成修复基线。
en_tdlr: ROCOCO is a flow matching-based generative model combined with a UNet-based occlusion mask predictor that robustly completes occluded curvilinear object outlines without requiring prior occlusion information, substantially outperforming off-the-shelf inpainting baselines.
